title: Robotics and Automation
content: Robotics is an interdisciplinary field that integrates computer science and engineering. Robots are programmable machines capable of carrying out complex actions autonomously or semi-autonomously. Industrial robots are used in manufacturing for tasks like welding painting and assembly. Service robots assist humans in domestic healthcare and exploration environments. Robot operating system ROS provides libraries and tools for building robot applications. Computer vision and sensor fusion enable robots to perceive and navigate their environment.
